_comment: The gear cutter's build (GearCutter/README.md, 'Build order', #480): its ten stages after the frame and their materials, in the only order they go in; read by Machines/Core/MachineBuildJson.cs (its schema) and kept by the shared machine base (docs/modeling/machine-base.md). The spindle and the index are each fed the bill their own items once had (2 steel rods, 2 steel plates, one lot of metal parts), a material a click; every other stage takes one item. The cutter kit is the wearing part, fitted as the cutter stage and durable: it goes in with the durability it has left (uses is the kit item's durability, set when the game loads), is worn by GearCutterSettings.CutterWearPerGear over the oil's fill a gear, comes back out by Ctrl with what is left, and a spent one is gone. The master is the last stage, either temporal gear (picks: which one is drawn, and decides the gear size), and comes back off by Ctrl once the kit is out. No block: the cutter's records are its own in the recipe export, not the ore machines' generic ones.
